name: Desi garage mridangam skips
desc: UK desi-garage flavor: mridangam finger strokes (ta, ki, nam) skipping with ghost gains and late shuffle over a rotating thom bass-stroke euclid; ka ticks pan slowly, gumki slides answer at phrase ends.

rate.doc: pattern rate multiplier, bare JS arg

code.full: stack(s("[~ mridangam_ta ~ mridangam_ki] [~ ~ mridangam_nam ~] [~ mridangam_ta ~ ~] [mridangam_ki ~ mridangam_nam ~]").shape(.2).gain("[.45 .2 .32 .16]*4").late("[0 .02]*8").delay(${dly}), s("mridangam_thom(3,8,<0 2 4 6>)").shape(.25).gain(${gain}), s("[~ mridangam_ka]*4").gain(.18).pan(sine.range(.3,.7).slow(32)).every(8, x=>x.ply(2))).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
code.peak: stack(s("[mridangam_ta mridangam_ki ~ mridangam_ta] [~ mridangam_nam mridangam_ki ~] [mridangam_ta ~ mridangam_ki mridangam_nam] [~ mridangam_ki mridangam_ta <mridangam_nam [mridangam_ta mridangam_ta]>]").shape(.25).gain("[.48 .22 .34 .18]*4").late("[0 .018]*8").delay(${dly}), s("mridangam_thom(5,16,<0 2 4 6>)").shape(.3).gain(${gain}), s("mridangam_gumki(3,16,<8 10 12 14>)").gain(.35).lastOf(4, x=>x.ply(2)), s("[~ mridangam_ka]*4").gain(.2).pan(sine.range(.25,.75).slow(16))).fast(${rate}).orbit(2).play()
